variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: .410 Bore
variants.info:
You won't believe what Zarovian farmers are doing this time!
Convert your worn out MOSIN MAGANT (OBREZ) into a modern day FROLOVKA OBREZ that fires 410 bore rounds!

variants.name: 8x50mmR
variants.info: A rare Stalowan / Alpenstahlan conversion that makes your Obrez Pistol fire the larger 8x50mmR cartridge, increasing the power enough to stop a man up to a certain range. It does not perform as well at range, among other faults of the cartridge...
